transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello. Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. I can't really seem to keep things in order anymore. 

It's just... well, the tickets, the receipts, customer jobs... they all just sort of pile together at the shop. I look at it and... I don't really know what to handle first. So, I guess that's why I'm here.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried about not being able to manage these tasks at work?
Um... no, I don't think so. I don't really get anxious. It's just... things are piling up, and I need to get them done. That's all.
Do you have similar difficulties organizing or prioritizing tasks in other areas of your life, like at home or in personal responsibilities?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I mean, home is just home. I just do what I need to do around the house. It's mostly just the shop where things get out of hand.
Are there any other situations outside of work where you struggle with organizing or prioritizing tasks, like when you're working on a project or managing responsibilities?
Um... no. I don't really do projects. Like I said before, it's... it's just the shop. I just go to work and come home. There's not really anything else.
Do you often find it hard to get started on tasks at work, even when you know you need to do them?
Um... no, not really. The clothes are just sitting there, so... I just start the machines. Getting started isn't really the problem.
Do you find it hard to stay focused on tasks at work once you've started them, like getting distracted easily or losing track of what you're doing?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. I can start going over the dry-cleaning orders just fine, but... after a few minutes, my mind just wanders off. I'll start thinking about the labels, or... choir plans, or just things at home. And then... I realize I missed half of what I was actually supposed to check.
Do you also find your mind wandering or getting distracted easily in other situations, like during conversations, while reading, or doing something at home?
Um... no, not really. I don't read much anyway. And at home... I don't know, I just do what needs doing. I haven't really noticed it happening then.
Outside of work, do you ever feel restless or have trouble staying still, like you're always on the go or need to be doing something?
Um... no, not really. I'm on my feet a lot at the cleaners, so... when I get home, I mostly just sit. I don't really feel like I have to be moving around or anything.

Have you ever experienced similar issues with staying focused or getting distracted in other places, like school when you were younger or in other jobs, or is this something that only started happening at the shop?

Um... I suppose it's always been like this. I don't really like thinking back on school, but... yeah. My teachers used to tell my mother I was scattered. They said I was bright enough, but... I was always talking when I shouldn't, or losing my assignments. They always had to remind me to just finish what I was doing. So... no, it's not just the shop.
Do you notice these problems with staying focused or getting distracted in other parts of your life, like at home, in social situations, or when you’re trying to relax and watch TV?

Um... I'm not really sure. I don't go out much, so... social things aren't really an issue. And at home, I just... I don't know, I just watch whatever is on. I haven't really paid attention to whether I get distracted doing that.
Do you have trouble staying focused or getting distracted when you're at home doing something, like watching TV or listening to music?

Um... like I just said, I don't really know. The TV is just sort of on in the background. I'm not really trying to focus on it, so... I couldn't tell you if I get distracted or not. And I don't really listen to music. So... no, I guess not.
Do you sometimes have trouble staying focused or get distracted while doing something at home, even if it's just a simple task like cooking or cleaning?

Um... I suppose so. I don't really cook much. Just microwave things, mostly. And cleaning... I mean, I start cleaning up, but then I might see something else that needs doing, so I go do that instead. I don't know if that's being distracted, it's just... how I do things.
Do you sometimes have trouble finishing things you start, like chores or tasks, even if they’re small?

I suppose. Um... mostly at work, I guess. If someone tells me to do three things... like call the supplier, tag a silk blouse, and enter the receipt... I usually do the first one. But then... I don't know, I just get pulled into something else before the rest of it is finished. So... yeah.
Have you ever had trouble finishing things you start, like chores or tasks, when you're at home or in other places besides work?
Um... I don't really know. I don't think so. I just... I do what needs to get done at home. I don't really pay attention to if I finish it right away or not.
Do you often feel restless or find yourself fidgeting, even when you're not at work, like when you're sitting down at home or waiting in line somewhere?
Um... I don't really think about it. I guess I just... sit there. I don't know if I fidget more than anyone else. I just wait until it's my turn, or whatever.
Looking back, would you say these issues with focus and finishing tasks happen in most areas of your life, or are they mainly limited to work situations?
Um... mostly just work, I think. I don't really notice it anywhere else. Like I said, at home I just... get things done. So, yeah. Just work.
When you were a child, did you often have trouble staying focused or finishing tasks, even before you started working at the shop?

Um... I guess so. My mother used to say my teachers thought I was... scattered. Like, I was smart enough, but I was always talking when I wasn't supposed to, or... losing my homework. They always had to remind me to just... finish what I was doing. So, yeah, I guess it was happening back then, too.

Looking back over the past few months, have you noticed these symptoms — like trouble staying focused, getting distracted, or not finishing tasks — happening in places other than work, such as at home, in social situations, or during personal activities?

Well... work is definitely the main problem. We've had late orders at the shop, and... some confused billing. It causes some tense moments with the staff and the customers. But... I guess, yeah, maybe it happens other places too. Like at church. I was leading some planning for things there, but... I stepped back from it recently. People were just getting frustrated with me. So I just let it go.

Can you think of any specific examples from your daily life outside of work — like at home, in church, or during personal tasks — where your trouble focusing or finishing things has caused noticeable problems?

I don't know. I mean... I already mentioned the church thing. At home, it's just me, so... if I don't finish folding my laundry right away or whatever, it's not really a problem for anyone else. I just... I don't really have any other examples.
